title: Single-Dose One-Compartment IV Bolus PK
description: Foundational Monolix longitudinal one-compartment intravenous bolus pharmacokinetic model with linear clearance and companion plasma concentration dataset.
code:
; Single-dose one-compartment IV bolus model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Cl, V}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
ddt_Ac = -(Cl / V) * Ac
Cc = Ac / V

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Oral First-Order Absorption with Lag Time
description: One-compartment oral absorption PK model incorporating a gastrointestinal lag time (Tlag), depot compartment absorption rate ka, and linear elimination.
code:
; One-compartment oral absorption with lag time
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Tlag, ka, Cl, V}

PK:
depot(target = Ad, Tlag = Tlag)
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)

EQUATION:
ddt_Ad = -ka * Ad
ddt_Ac = ka * Ad - (Cl / V) * Ac
Cc = Ac / V

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Two-Compartment Nonlinear Michaelis-Menten Elimination
description: Two-compartment pharmacokinetic ODE system with saturable Michaelis-Menten metabolic clearance (Vm, Km) and reversible peripheral tissue distribution.
code:
; Two-compartment nonlinear Michaelis-Menten elimination model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Vm, Km, V1, Q, V2}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V1)
compartment(cmt = 2, amount = Ap, volume = V2)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
Cc = Ac / V1
ddt_Ac = -(Vm * Cc) / (Km + Cc) - (Q / V1) * Ac + (Q / V2) * Ap
ddt_Ap = (Q / V1) * Ac - (Q / V2) * Ap

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc}

title: Target-Mediated Drug Disposition (TMDD) mAb Model
description: Mechanistic monoclonal antibody TMDD ODE model capturing free drug, free receptor turnover (ksyn, kdeg), high-affinity complex binding, and internalization.
code:
; Target-Mediated Drug Disposition (TMDD) monoclonal antibody model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {kel, kpt, ktp, kon, koff, ksyn, kdeg, kint, V}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
C = Ac / V
ddt_Ac = -kel * Ac - kpt * Ac + ktp * At - kon * C * R * V + koff * RC * V
ddt_At = kpt * Ac - ktp * At
ddt_R  = ksyn - kdeg * R - kon * C * R + koff * RC
ddt_RC = kon * C * R - (koff + kint) * RC

OUTPUT:
output = {C}

title: Tumor Growth Inhibition (TGI) Oncology PK/PD
description: Simeoni-style oncology PK/PD model linking drug plasma exposure to proliferating tumor cells and transit-compartment apoptotic cell death.
code:
; Simeoni Tumor Growth Inhibition (TGI) Oncology PK/PD Model
[LONGITUDINAL]
input = {Cl, V, kg, kkill, ktr, Kmax}

PK:
compartment(cmt = 1, amount = Ac, volume = V)
iv(cmt = 1)

EQUATION:
Cc = Ac / V
Wtot = X1 + X2 + X3
ddt_Ac = -(Cl / V) * Ac
ddt_X1 = kg * X1 * (1.0 - Wtot / Kmax) - kkill * Cc * X1
ddt_X2 = kkill * Cc * X1 - ktr * X2
ddt_X3 = ktr * X2 - ktr * X3

OUTPUT:
output = {Cc, Wtot}
